title: A new approach for the model updating of $(\star,ε)$-palindromic systems with no spill-over
summary: In this paper, model updating problem of the $(\star, ε)$-palindromic system with no spill-over (PMUP) is considered. First, we drive the spectral decomposition of $(\star, ε)$-palindromic quadratic matrix polynomial $P(λ)$ by a standard pair $(X,\ J)$ and a parameter matrix $Γ$. And the structures of $Γ$ are provided when $J$ is assumed to be a block diagonal matrix. Using the spectral decomposition of $P(λ)$, a new sufficient solvable condition of the PMUP is provided and a set of analytical solutions is characterized.
